Maintainer-directed (「平台的技能是否需要改进也要写任务」). The UI skill recommends `tabbed` for complex objects, which gives required fields hidden across tabs and tabs cut off on phones (measured on HotCRM staging). Change the default to stacked groups, and add guidance on collapsed groups, columns and modal size. This is item 2 (forms) of the console core-UX epic #34571, which the maintainer graded all p1 (「刚才的问题立专题卡，都是p1」): **p1**.
